subject.title: feat: adopt shared OpenClaw design system palette

question: When should this stacked palette migration be allowed to leave draft given the private `@openclaw/design-system` dependency and global visual impact?
rationale: The diff is narrow, but safe merge depends on package distribution, stack sequencing, and visual direction decisions that cannot be resolved by a mechanical repair.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Package Access Works
options.body: Leave this PR draft until the base install stack can install in hosted CI/Vercel and the route screenshots are attached or otherwise inspectable.

options.title: Accept With Operator-Owned Credentialing
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers explicitly choose to operate a cross-repository credential and verify deploy/build behavior before production release.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: If the design-system package will remain private without a consumer credential path, pause this PR until packaging is settled.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until Package Access Works
recommendation.body: Leave this PR draft until the base install stack can install in hosted CI/Vercel and the route screenshots are attached or otherwise inspectable.
